description: Check availability for one domain through AIvikings. depth="confirm" (default) asks the registry and returns the price; depth="fast" answers quickly without a price. Each result has a status: available (confirmed by the registry, with price and is_premium), likely_available (no registration found by fast checks, NOT confirmed and has no price), taken, reserved, pending_delete, invalid, unsupported_tld, or unknown (see reason). Never tell the user a likely_available name is available or quote a price for it: confirm it first with depth="confirm". domain_type only classifies name length. Use get_domain_pricing for the full price schedule.
name: check_single_domain_availability
